title: Wasm code body size includes local variable declarations
summary: Each code body first gives the size in bytes; inside it is the local variable declaration vector first, followed by the instruction expression.
detail: Declare vectors to be compressed by repeat count and type. Two adjacent local variables have the same type and do not necessarily correspond to two declaration entries.
boundary: Function parameters come from the function type and are not listed repeatedly in this local declaration vector, but will occupy the local index.
relevance: When entering function bytecode from an offset, avoid decoding declaration bytes into opcodes or miscalculating the first local variable number.
